channel.title: CORE (@msc_core) — Official Music & Lunar Story Universe
channel.description: Official releases, 1080p lyric videos, and synchronized stories from CORE (@msc_core). "The music has a face. It's the story."

item.title: CORE — PAY THE PRICE (Official Lyric Video) — 🌑 ECLIPSE
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
Count the cost and pay the price — we don't bow twice in the same night!

The inaugural release of CORE (@msc_core). Set beneath a total eclipse over rain-slicked asphalt, PAY THE PRICE is an anthem of high-stakes resilience and crossing the point of no return.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FUEh69R0gsk

item.title: CORE — COLD ASPHALT (Official Lyric Video) — 🌑 NEW MOON
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
Cold asphalt, loose change in my coat — midnight speed, got the pedal on the floor!

2 A.M. grinding at the wooden desk with strong black tea in a rusty tin cup. Set in the nocturnal periphery of Ankara and Susuz under a steel-blue New Moon.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kfNMMacoEYQ

item.title: CORE — KISS ME WRONG (Official Lyric Video) — 🌓 FIRST QUARTER (DUSTY ROSE)
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
Kiss me wrong, hold me right — under yellow city lights! Let them talk, let them try, they don't get to name this night!

Last bus gone, the pavement shines. Beneath a dusty-rose First Quarter Moon and glowing apartment windows, two lovers choose each other against the judgment of the city.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oe7Fo2lctZA

item.title: CORE — KISS ME WRONG (Arabesque Version — Official Lyric Video) — 🌓 FIRST QUARTER (WARM AMBER)
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
Till that morning finds this street, love me in the light we make...

A deeply emotional, nocturnal Arabesque reinterpretation set in a cobblestone alley with wrought-iron balconies, crimson puddles, and a warm amber First Quarter Moon.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ty586G_5Zw

item.title: CORE — IF ONE REMAINS (DON'T LET THE OTHER FADE) (Official Lyric Video) — 🌘 WANING CRESCENT
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
If one remains, don't let the other fade — love was never meant to choose whose heart to save.

Something diminishes, yet never truly disappears. Under a Waning Crescent Moon in Susuz, two empty wooden chairs face the rain reflection of a love that outlives tragedy.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HqGNLXGMvec

item.title: CORE — BEAUTIFUL DAMAGE (Official Lyric Video) — 🌗 LAST QUARTER
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
We were real, but the damage wasn't — kept your shirt, but I left the closet!

A curled-up photo on the wooden ledge, a cold coffee mug beside the edge, and keys left by the window frame. Under a Silver-Lavender Last Quarter Moon, healing begins by keeping the good times and leaving the mess behind.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FLlPHaRnXME

item.title: CORE — WE OWN THE MORNING (Official Lyric Video) — 🌒 WAXING CRESCENT
item.dc:creator: CORE (@msc_core) · Koray Taşan
item.description:
We own the morning, we own the light — nothing left for us to hide!

5:15 A.M., the shutters rise, yellow cabs under fading skies, and two paper cups of hot black tea. Under a warm golden Waxing Crescent Moon, the night gives way to fearless new beginnings.

Watch on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0UhXR4mWc1Q
